text:
Somewhere between Prompt №37 and "Why isn't this working?"

I just started another AI course for designers because, apparently, in design, you're a lifelong student. Already late for the first lesson and having completely missed the second one (because, well… life), I've been spending my evenings chasing new prompt ideas and testing different workflows. Wild nights, I know.

And somewhere between Prompt №37 and "Why isn't this working?", I had a ridiculous thought. What if, when the workday is over, all our AI tools go to an AI agents café?

Claude is there. ChatGPT too. Figma AI joins a bit later. They order their digital coffees and start gossiping about their users.
"Mine keeps asking for one more iteration."
"Mine changes the prompt seventeen times and then goes back to the first version."
"Mine says, 'Just one quick question…' and then sends a five-paragraph prompt."
Okay, that last one sounds suspiciously like me.

So here's my question: Do you think your AI tools enjoy working with you? And maybe the bigger question: Would you enjoy working with yourself?
☕🤖
